# @three-ws/assets

> Find a ready-made 3D prop, rigged character, or motion clip on three.ws and add it to your project with the code that renders it. Free and public: no account, no API key, no payment.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assets-cli
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-assets-cli/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/assets
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assets-cli/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-assets-cli/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assets-cli/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assets-cli/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-assets-cli/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
